It causes bradykinin accumulation, leading to the swelling of various tissus, including upper airway. results.text: The use of diltiazem hydrochloride in cardiovascular disorders. It causes coronary and peripheral vasodilation, has a negative chronotropic and dromotropic effect, and little to no negative inotropic effect in patients with normal ventricular function.
